hooks.command: jq -r '[.tool_input.file_path, .tool_input.path, .tool_input.pattern, .tool_input.glob, .tool_input.command] | map(select(. != null)) | join("\n")' | sed -E 's/--env-file[= ][^ ]+//g' | { if grep -Eq "(^|[/[:space:]='\"])\.env(\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)?($|[^A-Za-z0-9_.-])|data/models/"; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Reading or editing env files and model files is blocked by project policy."}}'; else echo '{}'; fi; }

jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | { c=$(cat); r=''; if printf '%s' "$c" | grep -Eq 'git[[:space:]].*--no-verify|git[[:space:]]+commit[^;|&]*[[:space:]]-n([[:space:]]|$)'; then r='Skipping git hooks (--no-verify) is blocked by project policy.'; elif printf '%s' "$c" | grep -Eq 'git[[:space:]]+push([[:space:]][^;|&]*)?([[:space:]:]|refs/heads/)main($|[^A-Za-z0-9_./-])'; then r='Pushing to main is blocked. Open a pull request instead.'; elif printf '%s' "$c" | grep -Eq 'git[[:space:]]+push' && [ "$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null)" = main ]; then r='Pushing from main is blocked. Use a feature branch and a pull request.'; fi; if [ -n "$r" ]; then jq -n --arg r "$r" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:$r}}'; else echo '{}'; fi; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { f=$(cat); case "$f" in */package-lock.json|package-lock.json) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Editing package-lock.json by hand is blocked. Use npm to change it."}}' ;; *) echo '{}' ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.js|*.mjs|*.cjs|*.ts|*.tsx|*.json|*.css|*.html|*.md) npx --no-install prettier --write "$f" ;; esac; case "$f" in *.js|*.mjs|*.cjs|*.ts|*.tsx) npx --no-install eslint "$f" ;; esac; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) npx --no-install tsc --noEmit ;; esac; } 2>&1 || true

s=$(git status --short --branch 2>&1); jq -n --arg s "$s" '{systemMessage: ("Git status:\n" + $s), hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "SessionStart", additionalContext: ("Git status at session start:\n" + $s)}}'
